Options:
      --api-url <API_URL>  [env: BOAT_API_URL=]

      --timeout <SECS>     Timeout in seconds. Default: 30. 0 = no limit. Above 600 or 0, the output streams live and the command survives network cuts.

      --json               Force machine-readable JSON/JSONL output
      --no-update          Skip the automatic CLI update (also BOAT_NO_UPDATE=1) [env: BOAT_NO_UPDATE=]

      --kill <PID>         Stop a background process started with --detach, and every process it started.
      --attach <PID>       Print the output of a background process started with --detach as it writes it, from its start, until it ends. Same exit code.
